title: Kitchen waste composting leachate as compensatory carbon sources intensify nitrogen removal in sewage treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW01032B, Paper
Ke Xu, Wenhan Zhong, Tao Ding, Yuqian Wang, Aiju You, Ligang Luo, Lifang Hu
Composting leachate (CL) from kitchen waste composting presented a valuable carbon source for sewage treatment. This study explored the using of CL to enhance nitrogen removal in sewage treatment process....
